title: Philippines Rejects Chinese Claim to ‘Sovereign Rights’ Over Waters Around Batanes
author: Sebastian Strangio
text:
A screenshot from a video released by the Philippine Coast Guard (PCG) shows a rigid-hulled inflatable boat from PCG circling the Jia Ha Ke 7, a Chinese research vessel, in the waters off Batanes, Philippines, Oct. 1, 2026.
Credit: Philippine Coast Guard/Screenshot by The Diplomat
The Philippine government today rejected China’s assertion that it has sovereign rights and jurisdiction over waters off Batanes, the country’s northernmost province, a day after the Philippine Coast Guard (PCG) drove away a Chinese research vessel operating in the area.The PCG said yesterday that it had deployed its largest vessel and an aircraft to challenge the Jia Ha Ke 7, a Chinese research ship, that had been “loitering” around 37 nautical miles northwest of Batanes for the past four days. During the confrontation, PCG spokesperson Jay Tarriela said that a China Coast Guard vessel also moved in and “repeatedly tried to shield the research vessel and block the PCG ship.”[...]
